title: Identify non-carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one double bond a
question: Identify non-carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one double bond and also include a nitrogen atom. For each such molecule, return its ID, the total number of distinct atoms it contains, and the count of its double bonds.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_mols AS (
  SELECT m."XCL_010"
  FROM molecule AS m
  WHERE m."XCL_011" = '-'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b WHERE b."XCL_005" = m."XCL_010" AND b."XCL_006" = '=')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_010" AND a."XCL_003" = 'n')
)
SELECT
  q."XCL_010" AS molecule_id,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a."XCL_001") FROM atom a WHERE a."XCL_002" = q."XCL_010") AS distinct_atom_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(b."XCL_004") FROM bond b WHERE b."XCL_005" = q."XCL_010" AND b."XCL_006" = '=') AS double_bond_count
FROM qualifying_mols q
ORDER BY q."XCL_010"

JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002

GROUP BY m.XCL_010
